Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring law enforcement agencies and fire departments to suspend an employee who is involved in the use of illegal drugs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring law enforcement agencies and firedepartments to suspend an employee who is involved in the use ofillegal drugs; and adding a new section to chapter 43.101 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Law enforcement agencies and fire departments that have probablecause to believe an individual with the agency, including all employeesand officers of the agency, is involved in the use of illegal drugsshall immediately suspend that individual from his or her duties untilit is affirmatively determined by the agency either that (1) the personis not involved with illegal drug use, in which case the person mayresume their duties; or (2) the person was involved in illegal druguse, in which case the agency must take whatever disciplinary measuresit deems appropriate, including termination, and if the person is notterminated the person may not resume his or her duties until the agencyis satisfied the person is qualified to do so. The employee may be p. 1 HB 2627subject to random drug testing.
